mission.goal: Prioritize substantive remaining privacy, effect-correctness and retained-observation gaps from the comprehensive plan and beads; commit meaningful changes directly to main without PRs.

published_checkpoints.change: Existing-store QSR owner preserves effect state; standard and exact explicit capacities; native fixture and actual CLI regressions.
All eight alert observation/reconciliation wrappers bind exact retained intent and owned obligation before provider lookup.
Expand source ownership before audit classification; retain verified shared audit identities explicitly; reject malformed or foreign unowned candidates; preserve interrupted staging retries.

findings: QSR inspection previously opened the ordinary deployment initializer/reconciler, which could reclassify unrelated committed effects even when the requested report was subsequently refused.
Provider proofs were checked against the supplied alert plan, but reconciliation wrappers did not bind that plan's full intent to the journal operation sharing its operation ID.
Deletion omitted source/derivative bytes based on audit framing before computing direct and nested manifest ownership.
The repository's broad open beads include substantially implemented functionality; the selected fixes address observed contract defects rather than treating every open title as missing code.
decisions: Keep the QSR deployment handle inside a reference-owned existing-store reader. Preserve native source/privacy/deletion validation and report identity.
Use existing IdempotencyConflict and ObligationConflict contracts; preserve informational terminal predicates and exact successful recovery semantics.
Protect actual committed deletion and expiry audit identities from verified history, and expose shared audit bytes as retained deletion_audit_metadata.
Preserve concurrent upstream TCP/discovery cancellation and retained metadata-limit commits.
Do not introduce dependencies, substitute the runtime, relax qualification gates, or claim umbrella completion.

authority.user: Direct commits to main through GitHub, no PRs.
authority.scope: Repository implementation and deterministic fixtures; no live device changes or external messages.
authority.local_recovery: QSR still opens the exclusive local publisher and its recovery. It is not the immutable canonical fss/1 query boundary.
authority.deployment_limits: Layout v1 retains only a digest. Nonstandard QSR API callers must supply exact original limits; CLI retains standard-capacity support.
authority.release: Repository-owned local qualification and retained DSR receipts remain required.
